message.content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m2","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m3","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":2},{"ref":"m4","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":3},{"ref":"m5","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":4},{"ref":"m6","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":5},{"ref":"m7","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":6}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m2","type":"同伙","evidence":[{"quote":"這晚上照例有一臺戲，戲臺左近，也照例有許多的賭攤。","occurrence":0}]},{"subject_ref":"m3","object_ref":"m4","type":"同伙","evidence":[{"quote":"他只聽得樁家的歌唱了。他贏而又贏。銅錢變成角洋，角洋變成大洋，大洋又成了疊。","occurrence":1}]},{"subject_ref":"m5","object_ref":"m6","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"他不知道誰和誰爲什麽打起架來了。","occurrence":2}]},{"subject_ref":"m7","object_ref":"m6","type":"欺凌","evidence":[{"quote":"他如有所失的走進土穀祠，定一定神，知道他的一堆洋錢不見了。","occurrence":3}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
